More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both. Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience. All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan. Anything requiring clinical judgment beyond RN scope is routed to a physician, so sound escalation judgment is central to the role. jobs.title: Clinical Transcript Reviewer
jobs.description: Clinical Transcript Reviewer Please note that this is a rolling advert, and we have reached capacity on our current reviewer group. You are welcome to apply, and we will be in contact when we start the next recruitment round (TBC 2026-27). About Limbic Limbic is the leading clinical AI company for mental healthcare and the largest deployment of patient-facing mental health AI in the world. Our technology has supported over half a million patients across the UK and US, helping health systems deliver higher-quality, more accessible, and more efficient care. We regulated the first AI diagnostic model for adult mental health as a Class IIa medical device. We’ve published in top-tier journals, won major awards, and advise governments and regulators globally on AI safety, medical devices, and the future of clinical agentic systems. We now want to focus on providing direct-to-patient best in class AI-led care, and are recruiting to staff our exciting and progressive care clinic. Brief Job Description: We are seeking experienced US-licensed Psychotherapists or Psychologists to review transcripts of calls between our patients and our AI therapy agents. Your reviews will directly shape how we support real people seeking care; flagging risk, ensuring clinical appropriateness, and defining what "genuinely helpful" looks like at scale. This is flexible, remote, contract work well-suited to a licensed clinician who wants meaningful part-time work at the frontier of mental health care. Core Responsibilities Review conversation transcripts against clinical quality, accuracy, and safety standards Identify and flag clinical risk, safety concerns, and moments requiring human clinical judgment Assess whether responses are clinically appropriate, empathetic, and aligned with best practice Document clear, structured feedback that our clinical and product teams can act on Note: this role does not involve direct patient contact or care delivery. Any concerns are flagged to Limbic employed

jobs.title: Commercial Director - Obesity
jobs.description: About Numan Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health. Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life. To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: • Patients first. • Learn fast. • Own the quality. • Succeed together. • Care deeply. Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! The Role: The Commercial Director, Obesity owns the business in its entirety: the proposition, the P&L and the commercial outcomes. If obesity grows profitably, it's because this person made the right calls. If it doesn't, they'll already know why. Most of the levers sit in other teams. Marketing, CRM, product, pricing and clinical ops all shape the obesity P&L, so the Commercial Director has to direct resource they don't own. That resource is won with a clear commercial case and the numbers to back it. The person who excels here thinks like a founder. They know CAC, CM2, cohort retention and approval rate without being asked, and they read the weekly numbers hunting for the problem before anyone flags it. They care about patients, who come to Numan at a personal moment and need to trust us before they'll stay. You will: Own patient growth, revenue and CM2 for obesity. Set the plan, make the trade-offs and be accountable for the outcome. Decide what we sell, at what price and on what commitment. Better unit economics and a wider funnel often pull in opposite directions; this role finds the balance and makes the call. Lead the obesity commercial team and run the weekly obesity forum. jobs.title: Inpatient Coder Associate, Payment Integrity
jobs.description: The Payment Integrity team is a group of innovative thinkers sitting at the intersection of Clover's provider Network, Claims, and Tech teams. The Payment Integrity team ensures that Clover pays claims in an accurate manner, with a particular focus on reducing inappropriate medical spend. As an Inpatient Clinical Coder at Clover Health , you will play a key role ensuring that Clover is able to continue to build and scale a compliant, efficient and profitable program. You will work to ensure quality assurance standards and regulatory policy are reflected in claims processing practices. You will help drive value for every member by ensuring that Clover’s medical claims are paid accurately and recovering overpayments when they are identified. The Associate - Inpatient Coder coordinates the identification of provider DRG denials and upcoding. As an Inpatient Clinical Coder, you will: Partner with Clinical, Claims, and Payment Integrity peers to review claims for DRG related issues on a prospective and retrospective basis that drive inaccurate payments to providers. Proactively identify overpayments to ensure accurate claims payments on inpatient services. Participate in collaborative discussions with MDs to verify the clinical rationale behind billed procedures. Communicate effectively while building trust and lasting partnerships both laterally and vertically across multi-discipline teams. Communicate effectively both internally and externally to ensure accurate claims adjudication and proper provider notification. Success in this role looks like: By the end of your initial 90-day period, you will have demonstrated a strong understanding of clinical coding practices and medical records review, while assisting our team in areas of DRG validation. By 6 months, you will be working autonomously to execute within our clinical review workflows and will have developed strong interpersonal relationships across the organization. jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
